request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and resonant, acoustic guitar, cello, flute, light drums, solemn and majestic mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Eliel the Mahavite stood tall
Beside Jeribai and Joshaviah
Sons of Elnaam in the hall
With Ithmah the Moabite he stood

[Verse]
Mishmannah the fourth in the line
Jeremiah the fifth by design
Hebron's son Eliel the chief
Eighty relatives stood to keep

[Chorus]
Mighty warriors, men of renown
Heads of their fathers' houses down
Serving David with faith and might
In the wilderness they took their flight

[Verse]
Summoned priests Zadok and Abiathar
Levites Uriel, Asaiah, near
Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel
Amminadab answered the call

[Chorus]
Mighty warriors, men of renown
Heads of their fathers' houses down
Serving David with faith and might
In the wilderness they took their flight

[Bridge]
Supervisors under Conaniah's hand
Azariah in the holy land
Eliel oversaw the tithes
In the house of the Lord he strives

[Outro]
Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel
Names recorded for the world to see
